objective: Make multi-skill Figma work planned, progressive, visual-first, provider-safe and evidence-bound.
terminalTruth: Changed package bytes plus deterministic tests, a rendered work graph, full build, typed query/apply seams, and truthful live-boundary evidence.

nodes.label: Progressive execution contract
nodes.outcome: A validated work graph, immediate rolling notes and reasoning-shape representation selection are available to multi-skill authoring.
proof: Valid and invalid work-plan tests
Rendered SVG graph inspected
Authoring Skill exposes conditional activation
nonGoals: No planning ceremony for one-step edits
nodes.recovery: On context or runtime contradiction, update only the invalid node and re-render the frontier.

nodes.label: Deterministic Figma runtime SDK v2
nodes.outcome: Targeted page loading, complete async style/variable binding, append-before-fill sizing, idempotent cleanup, handoff inspection, undo checkpoints and structure measurement use one tested provider adapter.
nodes.entrypoint: controlmux helper injected into every figma_exec call
proof: Plugin handler tests exercise v1 compatibility and v2 positive/failure cases
Bundle smoke preserves plain native execution
Live v2 fixture returned native CSS/component identity and cleaned all temporary assets
nonGoals: No attempt to cancel synchronous Figma JavaScript
No replacement of native Plugin API
nodes.recovery: Timeout recovery remains inspect-before-retry; helper operations are idempotent where provider semantics allow.

nodes.label: Plan-aware operation telemetry
nodes.outcome: Every logical operation may identify plan, step and representation; UI exposes them without adding MCP tools.
proof: Schema and validation tests
Logical operation summary tests
Generated UI test and browser fixture markers
nonGoals: Telemetry does not become canonical planning state
No automatic PASS from declared steps
nodes.recovery: Legacy callers omit fields and retain current behavior.

nodes.label: Typed query/apply runtime platform
nodes.outcome: Common inventory and guarded file-owned cleanup use typed provider handlers and shared recipe transport; raw figma_exec remains an escape hatch.
proof: 21 test files / 97 tests and shipped bundle PASS
Stale bundle revision rejects v2 before queue
Telemetry delta cursor/upsert/remove/resync and peer-window load tests PASS
Live typed query inventory and guarded apply dry-run PASS at matching revision 3804fe4ab09d239d; core Runtime SDK v2 PASS
nonGoals: No mirror of the entire Figma API
No replacement of raw figma_exec for uncovered provider APIs
No automatic mutation from a query
nodes.recovery: If the companion becomes stale, reload the exact development manifest and rerun typed-tools-live; preserve any provider-limited sub-capability as BLOCKED.

nodes.label: Just-in-time specialist activation
nodes.outcome: Whole-scene authoring packetizes work, activates only decision-critical depth, notes immediately and compiles visual representations intentionally.
proof: Frozen positive/context-overload/visual-representation cases
Capability validator checks markers and resources
nonGoals: No preload of all Figma Skills
nodes.recovery: Return to the active packet and load a different owner only when evidence invalidates the selected decision boundary.

nodes.label: Reuse Registry contract
nodes.outcome: Local and cross-file component claims preserve identity, semantic job, source and verification state instead of relying on visual similarity.
nodes.entrypoint: component reuse registry schema and validation
proof: Schema/validator tests
Live local 11/11 instance evidence retained
Cross-file state remains NOT_RUN until executed
nonGoals: No claim of published library reuse without a second authorized file
nodes.recovery: Stale/missing source identity blocks reuse and routes to inspect or create; it never silently detaches.

nodes.label: Execution and representation evals
nodes.outcome: Planning completeness, progressive context and representation selection have falsifiable cases while comparative uplift remains frozen.
proof: Deterministic invariant tests PASS
Live MCP boundary read PASS (SDK_READ_OK) or exact NOT_CONNECTED
Behavioral A/B remains NOT_RUN
nodes.recovery: A failed mechanism case reopens only its owning node; a missing live provider keeps live proof NOT_RUN/BLOCKED.

nodes.label: Live Runtime SDK execution
nodes.outcome: The rebuilt companion advertises runtimeSdk v1 and v2 and executes plan-aware v2 reads plus a temporary native helper fixture against the connected Figma page.
nodes.entrypoint: npm run test:mcp-operation and npm run test:runtime-sdk-v2-live against a reloaded Figma companion
proof: figma_status runtimeSdks contains v1 and v2
SDK_READ_OK
v2 style/variable/CSS/component/undo fixture PASS
temporary assets removed and queue/in-flight return to zero
Dev Resource write remains BLOCKED_BY_PROVIDER HTTP 403
nonGoals: No inference from transport reconnect or semver alone
nodes.recovery: If the companion becomes stale or disconnected, reload Figma Plugin from the rebuilt development manifest; unsupported v2 companions fail before dispatch.

nodes.label: Design-to-code parity run
nodes.outcome: One measured Design Translation Packet is implemented and compared in a real browser against the exact Figma revision.
nodes.entrypoint: authorized target frontend repository plus translation packet
proof: Exact Figma revision
Production code mapping
Browser structural and visual parity evidence
nonGoals: No invented target codebase or production approval
nodes.recovery: Activate only after the user selects an authorized frontend target and expected parity obligations.
nodes.blocker: No target frontend repository or accepted implementation obligations are currently in scope.
